name: Zen Tint
description: Zen chrome that continues the page: the URL bar, sidebar and titlebar take the page's own declared background, and the page itself is framed by a squircle outline in a color the page contains. Optional video-aware visible-color sampling. Single rAF-coalesced sampler, per-origin LRU cache, no retry storms, no per-tab paint cascade. Built for heavy-tab sessions.
author: Zack-Bloodshot
